title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, or, a Dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature : enlarged and improved. Illustrated with nearly six hundred engravings - Fifth edition, Volume 14, MIC-NIC - EB.10
text: * His gown had fide [i, e. long] fleeser down to midleg, fit from the shoulder to the hand, and lined with white cotton. His double fleeser of black worelled: upon them a pair of points of never channeled along line with with blue threaden paintes. A wait towards the hands of fifidiananes. A pair of red weather flocks. A pair of pump on his feet, with a one cut at his best for curs; not new indeed, yet cleanly blackt with foot, and thinning as a thing here.
